security_audit.summary: All 46 static findings are false positives. The scanner interpreted Markdown inline-code delimiters as shell backticks, but SKILL.md contains Vue configuration and documentation references, not executable shell or Ruby commands. The reconnaissance matches are also ordinary renderer and security-policy guidance.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends a trusted HTML policy for explicitly trusted legacy content.
remediation.suggestion: Keep html-policy="safe" as the default and require a documented trust boundary before using html-policy="trusted" or disabling Mermaid strict mode.

content.value_statement: Vue teams can struggle to choose secure rendering modes and streaming settings. This skill provides focused guidance for integrating markstream-vue in Vue 3 applications.
actual_capabilities: Select chat, docs, or minimal rendering modes for Vue 3 surfaces.
Explain CSS import order and optional peer dependencies.
Configure streamed Markdown output and completed chat history.
Integrate Markstream with built-in or existing timeline virtualization.
Configure scoped custom Markdown components and plugin registration.
Highlight safe HTML and Mermaid defaults for untrusted content.
limitations: Applies to plain Vue 3 applications and does not provide Nuxt setup.
Does not install packages or modify project files by itself.
Does not replace project-specific build, typecheck, or browser testing.
Trusted HTML configuration requires the host application to define a trust boundary.

use_cases.title: Build a streaming chat interface
use_cases.description: Configure a Vue 3 chat row for paced Markdown streaming and stable completed-message rendering.

use_cases.title: Render large support threads
use_cases.description: Choose a virtual timeline strategy for long Markdown conversations without conflicting with an existing scroller.

use_cases.title: Create a documentation surface
use_cases.description: Set up rich Markdown rendering, optional code blocks, and safe HTML defaults for product documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Vue integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add markstream-vue to my plain Vue 3 app. Recommend the CSS import order and a simple content-based renderer.

prompt_templates.title: Configure chat streaming
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure markstream-vue for streamed AI chat responses in Vue 3. Use chat mode and explain settings for live output and completed history.

prompt_templates.title: Virtualize a message timeline
prompt_templates.prompt: My Vue 3 app uses vue-virtual-scroller. Show how to connect useMarkstreamVirtualAdapter and preserve measurement state across thread switches.

prompt_templates.title: Harden a rich renderer
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my markstream-vue configuration for untrusted Markdown. Keep safe HTML and Mermaid defaults, and identify any justified trusted-content exceptions.

output_examples.input: Configure a Vue 3 AI chat message renderer.
output: Use content for ordinary streamed Markdown.
Keep smooth streaming for live chunks and disable it after finalization.
Keep the same renderer mode for the chat row.

output_examples.input: Choose a strategy for a long message timeline.
output: Use MarkstreamVirtualTimeline when the application has no existing virtualizer.
Use the adapter with vue-virtual-scroller when that library already owns the timeline.
Measure the outer row and preserve thread state during switches.

best_practices: Confirm that the host application is Vue 3 and not Nuxt before applying the guidance.
Keep html-policy set to safe and Mermaid strict mode enabled for untrusted content.
Run the smallest relevant development, build, or typecheck command after integration.
anti_patterns: Do not use docs mode only to finalize an existing chat message.
Do not let nested virtualizers compete to control the same message timeline.
Do not enable trusted HTML for content without a documented trust boundary.

faq.question: Is this skill for Nuxt applications?
faq.answer: No. It targets plain Vue 3 applications. Use markstream-nuxt guidance for Nuxt-specific setup.

faq.question: Which renderer mode should I use for AI chat?
faq.answer: Use chat mode for streamed AI output and completed chat rows.

faq.question: When should I use docs mode?
faq.answer: Use docs mode for rich document surfaces that need its larger batches, tooltips, or code rendering.

faq.question: Can I use an existing virtual scroller?
faq.answer: Yes. Keep the existing outer virtualizer in control and use the Markstream adapter for Markdown items.

faq.question: Are HTML and Mermaid safe by default?
faq.answer: The guidance keeps html-policy set to safe and Mermaid strict mode enabled by default.

faq.question: Does the skill install dependencies?
faq.answer: No. It provides integration guidance. You choose and run the project package manager commands.
